source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
These are looking great — it’s really starting to feel like a real machine now. I like how the raised platform is integrating with the overall design and the proportions are coming together nicely.

A couple things I wanted to ask as the layout gets refined:

• What is the estimated cup clearance height under the spouts once everything is finalized? I just want to make sure standard cups fit comfortably underneath during pours.

• How are you planning to route the tubing/drain path from the bowls to the spouts? Mostly curious how hidden and serviceable that system will be.

• Will the bowls still be easy to remove for cleaning with the current tower spacing and motor placement?

• For maintenance down the line, how accessible will the motors/electronics be if anything ever needs adjustment or replacement?

Overall though, I really like the direction this is heading in. Excited to see the next phase come together.

value_updates.service_access: Internal tubing, motors, and electronics must remain accessible and serviceable for maintenance, adjustment, or replacement.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I'll check clearance height for the spouts today but it should be just a little over 5 inches. Maybe around 5.5. drain path from bowls to spouts will be completely hidden. Once a bowl is removed it is visible somewhat until a new bowl is placed in.
The whole system will be easily serviceable. The top and bottom panels are able to be removed if ever needed to service the machine. The towers for the motors are also able to be opened if needed to service the motors themselves.
Bowls will be easy to remove still.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the system is serviceable through removable top and bottom panels and openable motor towers.
